summary: Full regression of the Rewind demo todo app on desktop 1280x800 and mobile 390x844, covering day-01 through day-04 scenarios plus the product smoke check. Add, trim, reject empty titles, tick, delete, keyboard use, long and rapid input, reload, and the back button all behaved as specified. No console errors and no new bugs; known-bugs.json was empty so nothing to re-check.

scenarios.title: Open the app empty state
scenarios.notes: Heading Todos, New todo field, Add button, No todos yet, and Format version 1 all visible. No console errors on desktop or mobile.

scenarios.title: Add a todo with the Add button
scenarios.notes: Walk the dog appears in the list and the field clears. Repeated on mobile.

scenarios.title: Add a todo by pressing Enter
scenarios.notes: Buy groceries is added in order. Repeated on mobile.

scenarios.title: Reject empty and spaces-only titles
scenarios.notes: Empty Add/Enter and spaces-only titles add nothing. Repeated on mobile.

scenarios.title: Trim leading and trailing spaces
scenarios.notes: Buy milk   appears as Buy milk. Repeated on mobile.

scenarios.title: Add a 500-character title
scenarios.notes: Title wraps, page stays usable, no horizontal overflow on desktop or mobile.

scenarios.title: Add 20 todos quickly
scenarios.notes: All 20 appear in the order they were added. Repeated on mobile.

scenarios.title: Tick and untick a todo
scenarios.notes: Checked todo is struck through; untick restores normal text. Repeated on mobile.

scenarios.title: Delete a todo in the middle of the list
scenarios.notes: Only the deleted item disappears; neighbors stay. Repeated on mobile.

scenarios.title: Delete all todos
scenarios.notes: No todos yet. shows again. Repeated on mobile.

scenarios.title: Footer format version
scenarios.notes: Footer shows Format version 1 on both viewports.

scenarios.title: Keyboard-only add, tick, and delete
scenarios.notes: Tab, typing, Enter, and Space add, toggle, and delete todos.

scenarios.title: Repeat S2-S10 on mobile 390x844
scenarios.notes: Same behaviors work; nothing overflows the screen.

scenarios.title: Product smoke check on desktop and mobile
scenarios.notes: Load, add two todos, toggle done, delete, footer, and keyboard all pass. Day 02-04 have no extra UI.

scenarios.notes: Demo app smoke passed on desktop and mobile.

scenarios.notes: Demo app smoke passed on desktop and mobile.
